name: @omp-dev-team/local-llm
description: Hardware-aware local LLM setup for OMP (Ollama / llama.cpp).
comment: The extension detects VRAM/RAM, builds a per-role plan from extensions/lib/catalog.ts via selector.ts, and registers the fitting models as the 'local-llm' provider (pi.registerProvider). The same CLI (bun extensions/local-llm.ts --json) drives install.sh/ps1, which installs the backend + pulls the models + wires roles.
